evidence.reason: Line 82 compiles and executes the helper without translating SyntaxError into the controller's refusal/error path. The adjacent live-binding loader catches SyntaxError at line 116, but _load_helper only wraps an unreadable file. A readable helper with invalid syntax therefore raises SyntaxError past the helper-load boundary, so a --json run cannot emit the required { error: … } object on stdout and instead produces a traceback on stderr, violating the current I1 machine-mode error contract. This is an existing error-path implementation defect, not a new requirement.
